# jumpcloud_approval_flow_settings (Resource)

Manages organization-level JumpCloud approval flow settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_approval_flow_settings" "example" {
  admin_approval_email     = true
  expose_approval_progress = true
  resource_request         = true
  user_approval_email      = true
  user_request_email       = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_approval_email` (Boolean) Whether to send email notifications to admins for approval requests.
- `expose_approval_progress` (Boolean) Whether to expose approval progress to requesters.
- `resource_request` (Boolean) Whether resource requests are enabled.
- `user_approval_email` (Boolean) Whether to send email to users when their request is approved.
- `user_request_email` (Boolean) Whether to send email confirmation to users when they submit a request.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the settings.
